description: Defines a custom ListView control 'OperatorPanelListView' for the CalculatorApp, handling scrolling behavior with custom buttons and pointer events.

classes.name: OperatorPanelListView
classes.description: A sealed class extending ListView, providing custom scrolling controls and pointer event handling for the operator panel.

methods.name: OnApplyTemplate
methods.description: Overrides the method to initialize template parts and attach event handlers.

methods.name: OnScrollClick
methods.description: Handles click events on scroll buttons to scroll left or right.

methods.name: OnPointerEntered
methods.description: Handles pointer entering the control, updating scroll buttons if the device is a mouse.

methods.name: OnPointerExited
methods.description: Handles pointer exiting the control, hiding scroll buttons.

methods.name: OnButtonPointerExited
methods.description: Handles pointer exit events on scroll buttons, preventing event bubbling if button is not visible.

methods.name: ScrollViewChanged
methods.description: Updates scroll buttons visibility when the scroll view changes.

methods.name: ShowHideScrollButtons
methods.description: Sets visibility of left and right scroll buttons.

methods.name: UpdateScrollButtons
methods.description: Determines whether to show or hide scroll buttons based on content and scroll position.

methods.name: ScrollLeft
methods.description: Scrolls the view to the left by a ratio of the viewport width.

methods.name: ScrollRight
methods.description: Scrolls the view to the right by a ratio of the viewport width.
